title: Let's get you scanning.
subtitle: Stampeo turns your customers' phones into loyalty cards. You scan, they collect.

business.title: Setting up a new business?
business.body: Creating a business happens on stampeo.app, where you'll pick your card, your rewards and your plan.
business.employeeNote: Working at a shop that already uses Stampeo? Ask whoever runs it for a team code. You don't need to create anything.
